name: Coldplay Canoodlers
storyline:
During Coldplay's electrifying performance at Gillette Stadium in Boston, what started as a routine "kiss cam" moment quickly turned into the most talked-about concert incident of 2025.

Now you can experience this iconic moment through our interactive game - will you handle the spotlight better than they did?
summary: A hidden‑object game released immediately after the infamous Coldplay concert kiss-cam incident on July 16, 2025. Players must spot and click on a pixel art couple in the crowd, earning 10 points per find. Created in under 24 hours by Jonathan Mann using "vibe coding"
